punchline: Students who could swap their photo almost never did, and liked it less.
thirty_sec: In a Harvard photography study, 64 students had to give up one of two prints. Those who could change their minds liked the print they kept less than those whose choice was final, even though almost nobody swapped.
question: Which decision of yours is still half-open because you can always go back?
key_contrast: An unused exit still cost the pleasure of the choice.
